[Section] Conclusions and Future Work
[source_id=22] Our results show that existing NLP systems cannot accurately perform sentiment analysis of political tweets in the dataset we experimented with. Labeling by humans, even non-expert crowdworkers, yields accuracy results that are well above the results of existing automated NLP systems. In future work we will therefore use a crowdworker-labeled dataset to train a new machine-learning based NLP system for tweet analysis. We will ensure that the training data is balanced among classes. Our plan is to use state-of-the-art deep neural networks and compare their performance for entity-level sentiment analysis of political tweets.
